Proposed diagram changes
  |-- Canvas domain model - baseline 03f2168 (before tldraw)  existing canvas
  |   |-- [1a] Correct: MappingPage
  |   |   `-- Replace the DiagramService content-writer account with explicit revision issuance and retention; keep CanvasWorkspace and controller ownership intact.
  |   |-- [1b] Extend: MappingPage
  |   |   `-- Add saved CanvasViews and generation checkpoints under CanvasHistoryService, and identify the controller as the publication boundary.
  |   |-- [4] Redraw: [D] Controller edits / agent access
  |   |   `-- Reorganize agent edits around default buffered exec batches, compact receipts, and atomic supplied-diagram batches; the former per-call exec flow is no longer the main contract.
  |   |-- [1b] Extend: [E] CanvasHistoryService / coordinated revisions
  |   |   `-- Add named-view checkpoint references, generation results, and retained alternative and review revisions without changing checkpoint ownership.
  |   `-- [4] Redraw: [G] DiagramService
  |       `-- Replace the sole content-writer service model with immutable revision operations, explicit runtime retention, and separate asynchronous generation.
  |-- AgentContext - implemented call flow and domain models (03f2168)  existing canvas
  |   |-- [1a] Correct: (O) Edit diagram with AgentContext - baseline 03f2168
  |   |   `-- Distinguish the still-supported single-edit run from atomic diagram batches; show saved-context resolution alongside scoped trajectory uploads.
  |   |-- [1b] Extend: [D3] AgentContext - implemented domain object and adapter
  |   |   `-- Add the durable AgentContextLibrary path while preserving trajectory capture, snapshot validation, and message conversion.
  |   `-- [2] Add: Saved AgentContext lifecycle
  |       `-- Detail create, source capture, persistence, read, and resolution from the overview's explicit AgentContextService and saved-context component.
  |-- Mapping page - MCP and HTTP API  existing canvas
  |   |-- [4] Redraw: Mapping page: exposed interfaces at 03f2168
  |   |   `-- Reorganize the interface inventory around bound and unbound tools, canvas.read, batched exec, supplied diagram batches, CanvasViews, AgentChat, and generation routes; the twelve-tool inventory is obsolete.
  |   |-- [4] Redraw: Mapping backend: grouped responsibilities (03f2168)
  |   |   `-- Recast request routing around bindings, compact reads, buffered mutations, asynchronous diagram runs, chat, and proposal services while retaining the live bridge and persistence boundaries.
  |   |-- [2] Add: Buffered exec and mutation receipts
  |   |   `-- Detail flush boundaries, one controller commit per batch, dependent queued IDs, and retryable receipts from the backend overview's exec component.
  |   `-- [2] Add: Bound canvas reads
  |       `-- Detail turn-scoped bindings, read aliases, small/full projections, and attachment checks from its live canvas API component.
  |-- PersistentLayer  existing canvas
  |   `-- [1b] Extend: PersistentLayer
  |       `-- Add durable chat and saved-AgentContext records, generation checkpoint references, and checkpoint-based catalog publication under their respective storage owners; keep workspace autosave distinct from publication.
  |-- ChangeSession - domain model and call tree  existing canvas
  |   |-- [1b] Extend: [MODEL] ChangeSession ownership
  |   |   `-- Add pinned repository context, captured hunks, DiffTree, and migration records to the existing proposal model.
  |   |-- [1b] Extend: [CALLS] ChangeSession operations
  |   |   `-- Add repository-scoped capture and the managed DiffSession workflow as callers of ChangeSessionService, without treating them as proposal editing operations.
  |   `-- [1a] Correct: [A] Ready validation and atomic acceptance
  |       `-- Include DiffTree and migration validation and the current baseline-diagram connection rule; retain atomic catalog acceptance and receipt recovery.
  |-- Workspace persistence flow  existing canvas
  |   `-- [1b] Extend: Workspace persistence flow - baseline 03f2168
  |       `-- Show checkpoint publication reading persisted workspace records, separate from autosave; attach it to the existing explicit catalog publication component.
  |-- 01 - Saved CanvasViews and branching  existing canvas
  |   |-- [1b] Extend: Saved CanvasViews and branching
  |   |   `-- Add generation candidate views pinned to one saved parent checkpoint, with queued-to-terminal status and immutable completed endpoints.
  |   `-- [2] Add: Generated CanvasView checkpoints
  |       `-- Detail CanvasHistory.startGeneration and updateGeneration from the diagram's generation candidate views component, including validation and idempotent result publication.
  |-- AgentChat runtime and managed canvas generation  new canvas [3]
  |   |-- AgentChat ownership and turns
  |   |   `-- Show AgentChatService, Codex connection, tool bindings, streamed events, and FileChatStore; connect to the Mapping backend's AgentChat component.
  |   |-- Supplied diagram tools
  |   |   `-- Show ChatDiagramTools resolving pinned references before DiagramBatchService submits one atomic controller application; connect to the backend's diagram batch component.
  |   `-- Managed generation lifecycle
  |       `-- Show parent chat, independent child chats, GenerationCanvasBridge controllers, persistence, cancellation, and reconnect reconciliation; connect to the saved CanvasViews generation component.
  `-- Repository push and DiffSession workflow  new canvas [3]
      |-- Push-to-workflow ownership
      |   `-- Show connection validation, event deduplication, Git resolution, and PushIntegrationService starting DiffSessionWorkflowService; connect to ChangeSession's managed workflow component.
      `-- DiffSession run lifecycle
          `-- Show pinned capture, agent steps, proposal readiness, artifacts, cancellation, and persisted run status without folding them into ChangeSessionService's proposal lifecycle.
